scientific_scope_status: For two finite stochastic channels K and L with a shared input alphabet and any finite c≥0, uniform complete equal-reference Umegaki comparison is equivalent to the conditional Umegaki comparison and to the complete SLD metric comparison, with arbitrary finite quantum references. A comparison between two classical channels only. It is not a theorem about a single classical channel versus identity, nor does it imply equality for arbitrary quantum channels.
